title_en: Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Administration of Entrusted Forensic Appraisal by People's Courts

articles.content_en: Article 1 These Measures are formulated pursuant to the Interim Provisions on Judicial Expert Evaluation Work of the People's Courts for the purpose of regulating the external entrustment and organization of judicial expert evaluation by the People's Courts.

Article 2 The judicial expert evaluation institution of a People's Court shall be responsible for uniformly handling the external entrustment and organization of judicial expert evaluation. A People's Court that has not established a judicial expert evaluation institution may assign full-time judicial expert evaluation personnel in its judicial administration department, and such department shall exercise the responsibility of external entrustment of judicial expert evaluation on its behalf.

Article 3 The judicial expert evaluation institution of a People's Court shall establish a roster of social expert evaluation institutions and expert evaluators (hereinafter referred to as expert evaluators), and shall, pursuant to the professional and technical requirements of the subject matter of evaluation, randomly select and entrust expert evaluators to conduct judicial expert evaluation.

Article 6 The judicial expert evaluation institution of a People's Court shall comprehensively review the expert evaluators who have submitted applications, and shall select the best to determine the candidate list of expert evaluators for external entrustment and organization of judicial expert evaluation.

Article 7 For entities and individuals applying to enter the roster of expert evaluators of a local People's Court, their qualification for entry shall be reviewed by the judicial expert evaluation institution of the relevant People's Court, submitted to the judicial expert evaluation institution of the next higher People's Court for approval, and reported to the judicial expert evaluation institution of the Supreme People's Court for record.
Article 8 The expert evaluators who have been approved and included in the roster of judicial expert evaluators of the People's Court shall be publicly announced in the People's Court Daily.

Article 10 The judicial expert evaluation institution of a People's Court shall, pursuant to the principle of respecting the choice of the parties and combining it with the designation by the People's Court, organize the external entrustment of judicial expert evaluation for both parties to the litigation.
If the two parties to the litigation fail to reach agreement through consultation, the judicial expert evaluation institution of the People's Court shall select an entrusted expert evaluator from among the expert evaluators included in the roster who meet the evaluation requirements.

Article 11 Where the specialty involved in judicial expert evaluation is not included in the roster, the judicial expert evaluation institution of a People's Court may select the best entrusted entity or professional from relevant social specialties to conduct the evaluation. If the selected entity or professional needs to enter the roster of expert evaluators, it shall still be submitted to the judicial expert evaluation institution of the next higher People's Court for approval.
Article 12 Where circumstances such as that an expert evaluator shall withdraw occur, the relevant judicial expert evaluation institution of the People's Court shall select a new expert evaluator.

Article 13 Where the judicial expert evaluation institution of a People's Court externally entrusts an evaluation, it shall assign a person to be responsible for coordination, proactively understand the relevant circumstances of the evaluation, and promptly handle issues that may affect the evaluation.

Article 14 Where an entrusted expert evaluator deems it necessary to supplement evaluation materials, and if it is truly difficult for the party applying for evaluation to provide them, the evaluator may submit a request to the relevant judicial expert evaluation institution of the People's Court, and the People's Court shall decide to collect the evaluation materials ex officio.

Article 15 An expert evaluator shall perform the obligation of appearing in court to accept cross-examination according to law. The judicial expert evaluation institution of a People's Court shall coordinate to facilitate the expert evaluator's appearance in court.

Article 16 If an expert evaluator included in the roster fails to perform its obligations or violates the relevant provisions on judicial expert evaluation, the relevant People's Court shall, depending on the circumstances, cancel its qualification for entry into the roster, and make a public announcement in the People's Court Daily.
